placements.overview: SSM College of Engineering, is located in Baramulla, Jammu and Kashmir. Established in 1998, it is a private institute approved by AICTE. SSM College of Engineering provides 12 UG and PG courses in 7 specialisations, namely Civil Engineering, Computer Science Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Electronics and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Theses programmes are offered in Full Time mode. B.E. / B.Tech, M.E./M.Tech, MBA/PGDM, M.Sc. and MCA are some of the courses offered at SSM College of Engineering. Some of the streams in which these courses are offered include Engineering, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software and Science. The total fee at SSM College of Engineering ranges between INR 90,000 to 1,80,000. SSM College of Engineering has a student intake of 1026 for all the courses. The average median package at SSM College of Engineering is INR 3,63,333. SSM College of Engineering offers all the infrastructural facilities to students.

review_summary.college_name: SSM College of Engineering Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied because of no placements.

content.Placements: My batch was 2018-2022. There were 200 students in my batch and other 1200 students were in Civil, mechanical and E&c department. My course was CSE and there were 2 sections (A&B). We finished our course and recruiting companies came to our college but didn't offer much. The highest package was 1.2 Lacs per annum, which was below average itself. I personally chose not join any company and decided to do my M.Teach. Companies were TCS, Wipro, Infosys, Hcl, Reliance etc. 60 % of students including myself got internship at Internshala. Top roles which offered were Software developed, web designer, It project manager etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Review of SSM College of Engineering.

content.Placements: Around 60 students got placed through the entrance JKCET, and few seats were reserved for fee quota. The average salary package offered was around 5 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Intel, Google, Amazon, Jio, etc.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure was good. I would rate it 1 star for infrastructure.
content.Faculty: Our teachers were less effective, and whatever they taught was irrelevant. Semester exams were conducted during winter, and it was tough for students. There were two exam papers in a single day.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: I am satisfied with this college.

content.Placements: The placement percentage is very less or negligible in our college. Hardly any company visited the college during our time and in fact, the college did not have any placement cell. They recently made a placement cell that hardly recruited any students. SSM College is below par as far as placements are concerned.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good. Our college has good labs and classrooms. A hostel facility is also available for boys. Our college does not have any hostel for girls. Some private hostels are available outside the colleges for girls and boys. The college has a good canteen and some other private restaurants so food quality is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: The college has really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: Some companies come to the college for placements. I don't know about the packages yet. Students must have 79% to get internships in good companies. Roles like software engineer, data scientist, etc., are offered in this course.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel, labs, library, Wi-Fi, buses and campus infrastructure are very good. The quality of food available in the hostel mess and canteen is very good. Various facilities of sports and games are available in college, like cricket, football, volleyball etc.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Civil Engineering - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good environment.

content.Placements: Around 70% of students are placed in a good position in government departments. If you are a hard worker college is providing a good environment to flourish in any field.
content.Infrastructure: College has very good infrastructure, especially the library, hostel, classrooms, and admin block are awesome. Being a private college infrastructure is good. College has a start of the art infrastructure.
content.Faculty: College is not that good in terms of faculty and teaching. College is affiliated with university of Kashmir which is the top university. University of Kashmir is NAAC accredited A+ university.

content.Placements: Top package was 20 Lacs per annum. As per my classmate, we have done a project in Coca-Cola Company Pvt Ltd. All my friends and I have gone for many industrial tours to several companies. My friends are all settled well, and they got time to learn in the college. Faculty supported us well.
content.Infrastructure: I am a day scholar, and I have written ICET. I got this placement, and my degree was also done in the same college, so I chose this college for MBA. A place where you find peaceful education. Hostel was not provided by the college; only the girls' hostel was provided.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: This is a very good college to study.

content.Placements: I started my BBA course in 2021 during lockdown, but the efforts and the way of responding to the faculty members are very good. Our seniors get placed in different companies, and they are very happy that they are placed in very good companies, and the college atmosphere is also very good.
content.Infrastructure: It has good libraries and it is very useful for the students, and laboratories are very good. The classrooms are clean and the course dates and examinations are doing very well, and the syllabus coverage is also very good.

review_summary.college_name: City College of Management and Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: 100% of students got placed from our course. The highest package is 10 LPA and 2.5 LPA is the lowest. HDFC Life, Shriram Finance, and Aditya Birla are the top recruiting companies. 100% of students got internships in HDFC Life, Genpact, and Shriram Finance. Roles offered are data analyst and HR manager.
content.Infrastructure: Labs, classrooms, library, and Wi-Fi are facilities and infrastructure available in our course. The facilities in our hotel are so good and the quality of food is the best. Canteens have many facilities for students, they provide us with the best food and packaged items.

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: I'm satisfied with the college.

content.Placements: 100% of students got placed from our course. The highest is 10 LPA and the lowest is 2.5 LPA. HDFC Life, Sriram Finance, and Aditya Birla are some of the top recruiting companies. 100% of students got internships in Sriram Finance, HDFC Life, and Genpact. Roles offered are data analyst and HR manager.
content.Infrastructure: Classrooms, library, Wi-Fi, labs, and all the facilities are available in our course. The facilities of our hostel are so good, and the quality of food is the best. Canteens have many facilities for the students, they provide us the fresh foods and packaged items.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Great environment for learning and development, but it needs more industry integration.

content.Placements: 63% of MCA students placed. The highest package was 45 LPA through off-campus international placements at companies like Microsoft, Amazon, Adobe, Infosys, TCS Digital, Wipro, etc. 70% of students in the 3rd year got internships. The top roles offered were Software Development Engineer (SDE), Data Analyst, Business Analyst, System Engineer, and Associate Consultant.
content.Infrastructure: Smart boards were available in some rooms for interactive sessions. Computer labs and hostels were Wi-Fi enabled with decent bandwidth. The central library had a wide range of technical books, journals, and research papers. Breakfast, lunch, evening snacks, and dinner were provided. The food quality was decent, with a balanced diet.

individual_reviews.course: Masters of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Our college has good faculty members and an environment.

content.Placements: Around 3-4 students got placed in our college. The highest salary package offered was 4 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Hyundai, Reliance, Siddhivinayak Group, etc. These companies provided fewer salary packages for students. Almost 50% of students got internships through their efforts. Top roles offered by companies were sales manager, business development, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provided basic facilities. The infrastructure of our college was average. Our college had a huge lab. Wi-Fi and classrooms were good. The library was not good because it had only a few books. The hostel provided facilities like Wi-Fi, food, etc. We used to play many sports in our college like basketball, volleyball, and kho-kho.

overview_faqs.question: Can SVKP & Dr. K S Raju Arts and Science College be considered a good college?
overview_faqs.answer: SVKP & Dr. K S Raju Arts and Science College is a reputed institute for MCA, MBA/PGDM, BCA, B.A., B.Com, B.Sc. Students can opt these programs to pursue their career in IT & Software, Business & Management Studies, Humanities & Social Sciences, Accounting & Commerce, Science. Institute has trained & experienced faculty who deliver these programs. SVKP & Dr. K S Raju Arts and Science College has a review rating of 4.1 on the basis of reviews by students. In addition to this, it has been rated 4.2 on campuslife, 3.2 on placements, 4.4 on faculty and 3.9 on Infrastructure.

review_summary.college_name: SVKP & Dr. K S Raju Arts and Science College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Botany, Zoology, Chemistry) - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: SVKP College view for the beginners.

content.Placements: There are so much chances in the chemical field and maximum number of students will get placements in our college. The highest package is 3 LPA. The average salary is 5 LPA. Top companies are Infosys, Wipro, etc. All the students will get internships, and the companies around us like Wanbury, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college infrastructure is very good and we have good advanced technology. Our labs are very good and these are helpful to do such practicals to improve our ability to make experiments. Our college has a nice playground, and we play so many games like badminton, basketball, and football courts.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Really good infrastructure with a green environment.

content.Placements: The percentage of students placed in the college is about 75%. The lowest package of the placement is INR 3.5 lacs per annum. The companies recruiting are multinational companies that did internships at our college; the percentage of internships is 50%.
content.Infrastructure: We had good infrastructure in our college buildings and big classrooms suitable for the students, and all over the college we have Wi-Fi facilities and computer labs. All departments labs are also available for the students.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Computer Applications (MCA) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Good college environment .

content.Placements: As it is a small college, MNC companies don't visit our college. But our placement cell officer helps us very much by sending the offline job notifications in our WhatsApp group. So that we can apply and attend the interviews to get the jobs. Placement support is there.
content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities available for our department like Wi-Fi, Labs, Classrooms, Library, placement cell, skill development classes, virtual classrooms, seminar halls etc. Seperate hostels are there for girls and boys. Mess food is good. In canteen only tiffins are available in the afternoon also. No meals are available. High importance is given to sports and games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Review of SVKP & Dr. K S Raju Arts and Science College.

content.Placements: Our college provides good placements. They offer low salary packages. Many companies visit our college to recruit students. Our college doesn't provide placements for other courses. Many students are struggling for job vacancies.
content.Infrastructure: Our college provides good facilities like a library, canteen, hostels, etc. Classrooms are good. Washrooms are clean. The food served in the canteen is good. Medical facilities are available in our college.
content.Faculty: Our teachers are the best. The teaching quality is good. Their behavior towards students is good. They are always available to clarify our doubts. The relationship between teachers and students is good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry) - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: I suggest our college only for hardworking students.

content.Placements: Our college provides average placements. Every year 70% of students will be placed from my course. Top recruiting companies like Wipro, Infosys, Tech Mahindra etc. Top roles offered in my course are system analyst, software developer, Software engineer etc. And we can also prepare for government exams in addition to the course. The highest package of my course is 5lpa and the lowest package offered is 3lpa the average salary offered is 2.5lpa. No students got internships from my course.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has better infrastructure, it provides pleasant environment for students to feel comfortable and study with out any stress. Our college has hostel facility, separate accommodation for boys and girls. The quality of food provides in the hostel is good along with the facilities, and vast classrooms with projectors. Contains labs for every course, And contains a library with variety of books for all courses. There is canteen facility with affordable prices, medical facilities, sports and games.

review_summary.college_name: Sona College of Technology Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Best life begin from best college.

content.Placements: 80 to 85 percent of students get placed in the last few years. Thanes salary package offer is at the maximum of 25 LPA and the average package of 5 to 7 LPA and the minimum of 3.5 LPA. Many companies visit our college like JSW, HCL, TCS, BROACH and so on. Almost all of the students get internship in the company.
content.Infrastructure: I am a NRI student. The hostel facilities are good and the food is good and hygienic. The infrastructure of the college is good. There are around 2 to 3 labs in each department and there are 3 canteens in our college. There is a high tech library with more than 100 systems. The quality of the food in the college canteen is good and cheap. There is a hospital for hostelers and it has a medical team of Sona AYUSH.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: College is our decision point in our lives.

content.Placements: In my course, almost 80-90% of students get placed. The highest package offered in my course ranges from 15-20 LPA. The average package ranges from 7-14 LPA. The lowest package ranges from 5-7 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are VEE Technologies, Consleague, TCS, etc. Mostly, all students get internships in companies through college. The top roles offered in our course are software development, frontend developer, web development, backend developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities of the college are very good and it has a large infrastructure. Our college has 3 canteens, and there is a big high-tech lab in our college. Food in the canteen is hygienic and good, but fully vegetarian. Our college has a medical team known as Sona Ayush. Many sports events are conducted in our college.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Mechatronics Engineering - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college, which can change our lives.

content.Placements: In my course, almost 80-90% of students get placed. The highest package in my course ranges from 15-20 LPA. The average package ranges from 7-14. The minimum package ranges from 5-7 LPA. The top recruiting companies for our course are VEE Technologies, Consleague, TCS, etc. Mostly, all students get internships in companies through college. The top roles offered in our course are automation, control systems, 3D modelling, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has 3 canteens, and there is a big high-tech lab in our college. Facilities in the hostel are not that much better, but okay, as we can manage. Food is hygienic and good, but fully vegetarian. Our college has a medical team known as Sona Ayush. Many sports events are conducted in our college.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the best college for MBA courses.

content.Placements: Approximately 62% of students were accepted into our college. The firms that were contracted included Amazon, Apple, BCG, etc. Approximately 60% secured internships based on our research. We could effortlessly join an interviewing company. The leading positions available include management consultant, product manager, etc. The salary spans from 15 LPA to 30 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: Our college offers outstanding facilities. Our college provides one computer per course. Our school offers Wi-Fi connectivity. The classrooms feature an impressive design. The food served at the hotel lacks flavor. The dishes served at the restaurant are delightful. Our college features clinics. Students are encouraged to participate in sports and other activities beyond the classroom.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering (AI and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The college is a good one for other students, and it's one of the best and most effective.

content.Placements: For our batch, approximately 85-90% of students from the AIML and CSE streams were successfully placed through campus recruitment. The highest package offered was around 20 LPA, typically by product companies, which is very good for the students and effective.

admission_process.title: Sona College of Technology Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Sona College of Technologyadmission 2025is open for various courses. The institute offers BTech/B.E, M.E/MTech, MBA and MCA courses at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses, the institute offers doctorate courses. The selection criteria are completely entrance-based. To get admitted to SCT, candidates must meet the eligibility criteria set by the institute. The college is affiliated withAnna University. The application process atSona College of Technologyis conducted both online/offline. Read the article to know more aboutSona College of Technologycourse admission2025.

Sona College of Technology course admissionis completely based on entrance exam scores such as TANCET, GATE, MAT etc. The college also acceptsPearson Undergraduate Entrance Examscores for UG courses. Students seeking to apply for any of the courses offered at the institute must fulfil the admission criteria of the desired programme before applying for it. Applicants need to register and appear for the accepted entrance exam before applying for the course. Students can refer to the table below to know about the eligibility and selection criteria criteria atSona College of Technology courses:
Based on the cut-off marks obtained in Class 12
Cut-off mark = 200 (100 for Mathematics and 100 for Physics + Chemistry)
Merit +TNEA counselling
TANCET/CET/GATE
MAT/TANCET/CET
UGC NET or GATE

Sona College of Technology admission processincludes several steps. Students applying for the programmes offered at the college must ensure to satisfy the course-specific admission criteria as per the college's guidelines. The entire application process is in online mode. Below is the step-wiseadmission process of Sona College of Technology:
Step 1: Sona College of Technology Application Process 2025

Interested candidates who fulfil the specified eligibility can visit the official website (https://www.sonatech.ac.in/admission/) of the college to fill out the application form. For PhD application, students must download the form, fill up the form and submit it. Candidates need to select the desired course, pay the application fee and upload the required documents to complete the registration.
Step 2: Sona College of Technology Selection Process

Once the registration is done, the candidates will be shortlisted based on the marks obtained in the entrance/qualifying exams for the respective courses they chose. The college takes into account both academic merit and entrance exam scores to make a merit list of the eligible candidates for each course. Students will be shortlisted by the college based on various parameters, including entrance exams, academic merit) etc. For PhD course admission, students are selected based on UGC NET or GATE.
Step 3: Counselling and Fee Payment

Once the candidates are shortlisted, the college may contact the candidate for counselling. Shortlisted aspirants need to come for document verification and pay theSona College of Technology feeto confirm their seats at the college.

placement_data.title: Sona College of Technology Placement Overview2024
paragraphs: Sona College of Technology has a placement cell that is responsible for securing lucrative career opportunities for students. The Cell creates awareness about “career planning" and "career mapping" among the students. It trains the students in various areas like Personality Development, Quantitative Aptitude, Logical Reasoning, Verbal Reasoning, Group Discussion techniques, etc. It is also responsible for conducting on-campus placement drives and organises a wide range of activities such as industry visits, live projects, workshops, guest lectures and seminars.

Recently, Sona College of Technology recorded 91% placements for the Class of 2024. As per the latest report, the highest domestic and international package offered during Sona College of Technology placements in 2024 stood at INR 19.94 LPA and INR 33.6 LPA, respectively. Further, the average package offered to the CSE, IT, ADS students of the batch 2024 stood at INR 5.4 LPA. As of Jul 2024, the participating recruiters presented 1,097 job offers to the batch 2024. The top recruiters of Sona College of Technology in 2024 included Accenture, Capgemini, Decathlon, L&T, Delta, Medtronic, Propel, etc.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Commerce (B.Com.) - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the quality of study, but the facilities are good, though.

content.Placements: 2 or 3 students got an internship from our college. 30 % of students get placed. Crete-like companies offer placement here, don't study here, it's the worst decision of my life. Choose some other colleges, it's a total waste of money studying here, I will not recommend it.
content.Infrastructure: Facility and infrastructure are good here. The facilities are so cooperative, and with that, they offer Wi-Fi labs, classrooms, a library, and a canteen. Infrastructure is good, though the quality of study is not good, and if you study here, it's not worth pursuing B.Com here.

individual_reviews.course: B.A. (Hons.) in Political Science - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: My college is very awesome, and teachers are also very good.

content.Placements: 80% of students were placed in our course. The highest package is 8 LPA, the lowest package is 1 LPA, and the average package is 4 LPA. No specific type of company is there for the course. 60% of students got internships from our course, and they are in many reputed companies.
content.Infrastructure: There are many facilities and infrastructure for our course. For example, there are Wi-Fi-connected labs, AC-connected labs, clean classrooms with AC and a projector, and a very good library with many types of books. Food is available in our hostel, and the canteen is very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Geology - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: There are good facilities and good infrastructure. But we need some instruments.

content.Placements: 80-90% of students got placed in our course. The salary is Rs 30,000 per month - Rs 1,50,000 per month. Recruiting companies are Oil India Company, Anglo American, Rio Tinto, Glencore, and Value. 30%-70% of students get internship courses like CIL, NMDC, Vedant, and Hindustan Copper. Analysis rocks very carefully. Very carefully check the rock.
content.Infrastructure: There are many more facilities in our department like high-speed Wi-Fi, and many books in our library. In our canteen, there is very delicious food. Many types of games are available. Our PT sir encourages many more sports. Canteen gives food at a low price.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Physics - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Maharaja, a perfect name for this college.

content.Placements: Our batch contains about 60 students now. The number of students after our batch has increased. There is no package provided by our college as I know. Internship is provided by private companies, which are not well known. Lab equipment was in shortage during our time, but now more equipment and facilities are provided.
content.Infrastructure: Class facilities of the department are very good. Our room can hold about 80+ students. The class has fans, LED bulbs, and a projector facility is also available with a chalk blackboard. Wi-Fi facilities are available. There is also a library, where all kinds of required books are available, with a reading room.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. (Hons.) in Chemistry - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied because of faculty, good placement, and really good infrastructure.

content.Placements: College gives you a better placement than any other colleges. It gives you more learning opportunities. It also provides many co-curricular activities for the growth of students. 80 percent of students were placed in our college. The highest package was 25 Lacs and the lowest is 1 lakh per annum. There are many well-developed companies that recruit students.
content.Infrastructure: The hostel and infrastructure are really great. It looks like our own home. The way of living is very good inside these hostels. It gives free Wi-Fi and better infrastructure and surroundings for studies. The quality of facilities is very good here.

School of Agri Business Management admission 2025 is open. Students interested can visit the official website and apply online.

School of Agri Business Management offers MBA as a popular programme to students. It is a PG-level programme and has a duration of 2 years. SABM MBA programme consists of 155 credit-hour courses, live projects, and various internship opportunities. The course is designed to prepare students for the industry level and to help them understand the practicality of the concepts. Further, the MBA programme mainly focuses on providing advanced professional skills to students including, soft skills and technical skills.

School of Agri Business Management admission is offered in online mode and the college conducts its own entrance exam. SABM entrance exam includes a multiple choice objective type written test, group discussions, and an interview in (English) of 400 marks. Candidates seeking admission to the MBA programme at School of Agri Business Management must have completed graduation with a minimum of 55% marks or equivalent in Agriculture, Horticulture, Fisheries, etc.

review_summary.college_name: Laxmi Devi Institute of Engineering and Technology (LIET) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: Empowering students and the mind.

content.Placements: An average of 80% students were placed from my course. The highest package was 5 LPA, the lowest package was 1 LPA, and the average package was 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies were Genpact, Hitachi, HDFC, and NXT. About 80% of students got successful internships from the course at Genpact and HDFC Bank. Top roles offered were administrative consultant and senior advisor.
content.Infrastructure: Facilities available were Wi-Fi, fan, light, library, and playground. The quality of hostel was good. All the things such as beds and almirah were provided. Mess was also good with fresh serving every day. Sports and medical facilities were overall perfect.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: My college days and college life.

content.Placements: A total of around 70 to 80% of students qualify for the placement round due to their qualification factors, like attendance percentage and their backlogs. The average package offered was around 3 LPA. Top recruiting companies are like Wipro, TCS, Mahindra, etc.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure was decent it contains of lecture halls, conference halls, different types of labs for different courses, library which contains more than 50,000 books, and a cafeteria. All over the college campus infrastructure was decent. The food quality that offered in hostel mess is also very good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: LIET – A base of upcoming engineers.

content.Placements: About 60% of the students were placed in this course because this course is very beneficial for the upcoming generation. The average package of this course is about 3.5–4.5 LPA, and companies like Infosys, Wipro, etc., gave internships to the students of this course.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of the college is very old, but still very strong. The facilities of the college are quite good. The labs, library, classrooms, etc., are well maintained, and the hostel and mess are also very good. The canteen is very large, and its food is also good. Sports and games are also played for physical fitness.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: Our college provides excellent opportunities.

content.Placements: Top recruiting companies like Wipro, TCS, HCL, Sony, etc., visited our campus. The salary package offered is 4 LPA. The recruitment of students on this campus is very formative, like a written test of reasoning and technical questions, and then they are shortlisted for the next interview round.
content.Infrastructure: Our college has many hostels like Karakoram, Vindhay, Niligari, Luxury, etc. Our college provides good facilities and safety for the girls' hostel. The college has good environment. The quality of the food is good. There are many instruments in the working labs of DC, MATLAB, ACS, and the machine lab. The lab assistant is supportive of students during the experiment.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: Review of Laxmi Devi Institute of Engineering and Technology.

content.Placements: Almost 3000 students got placed in this course. Top recruiting companies are Wipro, HCL, Amazon, etc. Around 80% of students got placed in this course. The highest salary package offered was 1 crore per annum at Google. The lowest salary package offered was 3.50 LPA at Wipro. Top roles offered are front-end developer, back-end developer, full stack developer, software developer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: All facilities are available such as Wi-Fi and laboratories. Our campus has good environment. There is a huge library and several books are available. Classrooms are well-maintained. Hostels are average. There is a garden on our campus. Swimming pool is also available. There is a huge auditorium in this college. Sports center is better. We also have a gym facility in this college. Canteen is available. There is a huge playground for sports like cricket and football.

review_summary.college_name: Indus Institute of Technology and Management (IITM Kanpur) Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Overall, the college was good.

content.Placements: In this college, the placements are good; in 2023, about 70% of students got placed in computer science engineering. The highest package was offered around INR 9 to 11 LPA and the lowest was around INR 3 to 4 LPA. Companies like HCL, Rigen, Quick Heal, and many more are coming. The internship was available for all the students.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of this college was awesome. All the facilities are available here. The classrooms are big and the smart board is available in all the classes. A very huge library was also present in this college. The hostel facility was available, which has good-quality of rooms. Sports and all the games were available in this college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: I'm absolutely satisfied with our college. Facilities, teachers and all things are good.

content.Placements: Placements are average here but not excellent. It is value for money. The top courses offered in our college are CSE, ME, CE, etc. Students who got internships from this college are mostly from CSE, ME, etc. The highest salary package offered is 8 LPA, and the average salary package offered is 6.5 LPA. The average salary package offered is 5 LPA.
content.Infrastructure: There is infrastructure for labs, course department and Wi-Fi. Classrooms are also good. The quality of facilities provided in this college and hostel is very good. The food served in the mess is very expensive and tasty. Medical facilities and sports and games are also available on this campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: This college is good for students' mindset because there are no problems created at this place.

content.Placements: Many companies visit our campus for placements, but these companies are very bad because they provide the jobs of helpers. So the selected students do not join these type of companies because there is no satisfaction and it's a waste of time. If you think this college has good placements, then you are wrong.
content.Infrastructure: All the facilities are available in the college like Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, library, and sports. There are separate hostels available for girls and boys. One more thing is that this college is situated in an open environment. All types of instruments are available in the labs, and they are good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2015
individual_reviews.title: Indus Institute of Technology and Management.

content.Placements: The placements are not good on the college campus. If you can clear interview so can join after an interview in the company. The college placed some students in Hyundai workshop in Faridabad. At the admission time, they promise for 100%, but it's the only a rumour, overall is good.
content.Infrastructure: The college campus has good infrastructure, and infrastructure is a copy of IIT Kanpur with separate boys and girls hostel. There is one cafeteria in separate campus mess for girls, boys and teachers. The computer lab is very authenticated with projector-camera class, and every class have seventy to hundred student capacity.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: This is a private institute affiliated to Dr A P J Abdul Kalam Lucknow University.

content.Placements: The placement of the seniors was good and about 70-80% of the students were selected in the campus placement. The stipend that was offered to the students was about Rs. 4-5 lacks per annum. The companies like Mahindra, Traquer, Dhenuka, Seahock have visited the campus. And, according to the development of the knowledge and skills during the tenure, the salary was offered to the students.
content.Infrastructure: The college has absolutely every facility such as the Wi-Fi facility, the labs, effective classrooms, proper library and medical facilities provided. The environmental conditions of the campus are too good for the students to increase their overall skills. The indoor and the outdoor games such as cricket, football, volleyball, badminton, carrom, chess, etc., are available in the campus.

review_summary.college_name: Al Falah University Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Computer Application (B.C.A.) - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely dissatisfied with the faculty members.

content.Placements: None of my friends got placements nor internships. The quality of education was also very bad. None of the teachers had coding skills. Only some of the other branches' students got placements and internships. I am not recommending this College for a coding background.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi was there, but access to students was limited. They didn't allow students to use college Wi-Fi. The canteen of the College and Hostel was too bad. Food quality was low, but cleanliness was there. Students were not allowed to go outside from the hostel in the evening. Strict rules for students.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech in Mechanical Engineering - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: It's a good college for students from middle-class families as its fee structure is low.

content.Placements: Because of Covid-19, companies stopped coming to college. That's why, the number of students in B.Tech is decreasing, but it's a very good university for medical students like MBBS and other medical courses. Medical students got placed in government hospitals and pharmacy companies.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure of our college is good, and it's improving day by day. There are many hostels available for students, and the size of the university is huge. They are increasing the number of seats per year, so more medical students can complete their studies.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: This is a very good college to take the degree and students can enjoy themselves.

content.Placements: Around 55% of students were placed. The highest salary package offered was 12 LPA, and the lowest salary package offered was 7 LPA. The recruiting companies were Mahindra, Tata Motors, Yamaha, Pride consulting services, Apollo Tyres, etc. Almost all the students got internships from different companies.
content.Infrastructure: Library of this college was excellent, where every student can issue any book from it. Classrooms were very good and students will enjoy sitting and reading in these rooms. There were many courses so the laboratories were many in this college and they were in better condition. Hostal facilities were very good and available good quality food in the hostel. Canteen were two in this college, and medical facilities were available 24X7, because it was offered the medical course in this university.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2020
individual_reviews.title: It is very good campus and everyone can enjoy yourself to being in this college.

content.Placements: 1. 60% students are placed in our course. 2. The highest package is 12 Lacs, medium is 8 Lacs and lower package is 4 Lacs annual. 3. Top recruiting companies are Mahindra, Tata Motors, and Maruti Suzuki. 4. Above 55% of students are got internships.
content.Infrastructure: In our college the facilities are available like it have their own medical College and hospital, hostal for students, canteen, two playing grounds. It have fully Wi-Fi connection, labs and excellent library service and all the books and patterns of books are available in the library.

individual_reviews.course: Bachelor of Business Administration (BBA) - Batch of 2019
individual_reviews.title: Dissatisfied with the facilities, but the teaching level is good.

content.Placements: My senior Mr Kalam Azad passed out last year got selected for an interview. The placement facilities are good, but it depends on a student that observed from teachers. Overall, the placements are in an average condition, and in all the things.
content.Infrastructure: Studies are okay, but the labs and practicals are low in condition because a lab is the most important part of engineering. They have poor facilities in labs and practicals. Everything is available, but the teachers do not take responsibility.

individual_reviews.title: Review of the Shiksha student.

content.Placements: The college has a nice placement percentage. The highest and the lowest packages offered to this college are more than 19 LPA to 6 LPA. Top recruiting company in this course. The number of internships in this course is more than 80 percent.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities and infrastructure available in this course are so good. Wi-Fi, classrooms, and a library are also present for the students. The classrooms are so good. The canteen food is very tasty, and sports and games are also available in the college.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence ) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Satisfied infrastructure and facilities are good.

content.Placements: The highest package of this college is 22 LPA and 44 LPA, and the lowest package is around 3-5 LPA. The placement percentage of this college is around 70-80%. Students are trained for the placement process with an additional fee. Top recruiting companies like Amazon, Deloitte, and TCS.
content.Infrastructure: College infrastructure is good and equipped with some of the latest trends. Labs are provided with Wi-Fi, air conditioning, and faculty with the latest generation computers. The food in the hostel is hygienic and good, whereas on some days it is not good. Multiple sports grounds are available.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence ) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The environment here is peaceful, and placements are good this year.

content.Placements: The placement percentage of this college is around 70% overall, and in the case of background, it is around 85%. Students are trained with CRT classes for the placement process. The top recruiting companies of this college are Amazon, Deloitte, and TCS. Placement will start from the 4th year, 1st semester.
content.Infrastructure: The college offers well-maintained hostels with a hygienic mess that serves snacks and meals at reasonable prices, ensuring students' health and affordability. A fully equipped campus health center with a visiting doctor is available on the campus. For recreation and overall development, the campus features excellent sports facilities, including a cricket ground, volleyball and basketball courts, as well as a dedicated space for various indoor games.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: The worst experience throughout my educational life.

content.Placements: Placements are comparatively low. In an average of 5000 students, only around 250 are getting placed. They don't give you any instructions on how to face an interview from the start. Only the last year students have such classes regarding placements.
content.Infrastructure: The infrastructure is quite nice and neat, except that the computers in the lab don't work properly. The Wi-Fi signal is also too weak to access. Even the mobile data signal is low. The hostel infrastructure is not at the top level. Since my first year, they have been building a new hostel block. Now I am in my third year, and it's still under construction. The food is comparatively good.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Great college, decent placements, quiet atmosphere and supportive faculty members.

content.Placements: Around 75% of the students from the last passing batch of B.Teach CSE were placed. The highest package offered was 21 LPA, with the average of 4.5-5.2 LPA and the lowest at 3 LPA. Top recruiters included Amazon, TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Cognizant and Capgemini. About 70% of the students secured internships in tech roles. This reflects the institute's consistent placement performance.
content.Infrastructure: The college offers well-maintained hostels with a hygienic mess that serves snacks and meals at reasonable prices, ensuring students' health and affordability. individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Good platform for students who want to pursue a degree, and the teaching is good.

content.Placements: 70% of students were placed in ECE. .4 LPA is the average package offered in this course. Zoho, Sifi, Hexaware, and Accenture are the top companies for this course. 50% of students got internships from your course, Software roles, DevOps, and graduate trainee.
content.Infrastructure: In our ECE department, there are many facilities like microprocessor and microcontroller lab, VLSI lab, network lab, digital signal processing lab, digital electronics lab and optical lab. Quality of food is medium, and the sports and games support is not enough.

individual_reviews.course: M.E. in Manufacturing Engineering - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Review of Velammal College of Engineering and Technology in 2025-26 course admission.

content.Placements: This college has every year total 60% of students to provide placements. A large number of students are available in this course. Internships are also offered. The average salary package offered ranges between 3 LPA - 27 LPA. However, this company does not offer any roles.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure quality is very good. Many facilities such as lab, bathroom, classrooms, drinking water machines, garden, canteen, hostel, etc., are available. In this college, canteen facilities are very good and tasty food is provided.

individual_reviews.course: Master of Business Administration (MBA) - Batch of 2021
individual_reviews.title: MBA from the Velammal College of engineering and technology.

content.Placements: Approximately 45–50% of the MBA students get placements at this institute. Our college placement cell organizes various on-campus placement drives. 12 LPA was the highest, 3 LPA was the lowest and 4-6 LPA was the average package offered in our course. Various management and consulting services firms visit our college for the placements.
content.Infrastructure: This institute has a decent infrastructure for the MBA course. The facilities of our college were good enough. All the necessary facilities, such as labs, libraries, canteens, Wi-Fi, etc., were given to the students. The hostel was available their for the students. The nearest bus stand was within walkable distance.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Electronics and Communication Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Velammal College of Engineering and Technology Canpus Review.

content.Placements: Students with 80% of marks in 12th board or management with a donation of ?4 lakh. The highest package offered was 20 LPA, the lowest package offered was 3 LPA, and the average package offered was 5-9 LPA. Top recruiting companies like Zoho, TCS, HCL, and Accenture recruit students. Internships will not be provided by the college. Core roles are very rare; mostly students are placed in the IT sector.
content.Infrastructure: The facilities are quite perfect for the requirements of the course. The whole college is designed as a single block which contains all departments. Canteen food is average. Hostel food is actually good. Hostel facilities are nice and good. Sports and games are available, but support won't be provided by the management.

individual_reviews.course: B.E. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: The college has the highest placement records.

content.Placements: As we have very good placements records in our college, the highest package offered by recruiters is around 12 Lacs per annum with an average package of 4.5 per annum and the lowest package offered is 3 Lacs per annum. Students with no arrears and the highest CGPA prefer placements.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is a famous engineering college in Madurai. It provides all the facilities within the campus itself. The laboratories are highly equipped and well maintained having air conditioners. All the medical facilities are available within our campus.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in CSE (Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning) - Batch of 2028
individual_reviews.title: Review of Sobhasaria Group of Institutions.

content.Placements: There are about 5000 students studying in this institution, and 20% of students are placed in my course, B.Tech AIML (CSE). The lowest package is 6 LPA, and the highest package is 15 to 20 LPA. Companies include Infosys, TCS, TISA, Wipro, etc. 100% of students got internships in TISA and more companies, with top roles including AI Researcher, ML Engineer, etc.
content.Infrastructure: Infrastructure, including Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and a three-floor library, is in very good condition with AC. Hostel facilities, including food quality and a canteen, provide quality food to the students. They have sports facilities that occur in summer, where the winners get rewards. Medical facilities are also available in the institution.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Electrical Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Absolutely satisfied with the faculty, good placement last year, happy to have good colleagues.

content.Placements: 40-50 percent of students got placed. The highest package is 7 LPA, the lowest is about 1 LPA-3 LPA, and the average is 4 LPA-5 LPA. Placement scenario in the college has recently increased as the number of students of electrical engineering has increased, and more for core branches.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi is good. Labs are mid, and classrooms are average. There is no boys' hostel. I can't say anything about the hostel facility. The library section is very well organised and students have a peaceful environment in that. The labs are to be improved due to the equipment shortage.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2029
individual_reviews.title: Average college outside the city, pollution, and between nature.

content.Placements: The average package is approximately 6 LPA. Last year's highest package was 20 LPA. Best college in comparison to other colleges in Sikar City.
content.Infrastructure: Good hostel facility with proper drainage and water system. This college comes under BTU( Bikaner Technical University).
content.Faculty: The faculty is good. The curriculum is also good you have 6 lectures, of which one lecture is always sports, but on Wednesday and Friday, you will get two sports periods. Exams are average, the questions are very easy, and all questions are repeated from the previous year's papers. The course is designed well, but for Computer Science students, there is no language in the first year. The rest is best in comparison to other colleges in the city.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science Engineering - Batch of 2026
individual_reviews.title: Do not come to this college.

content.Placements: Only a few companies account for 90 percent of sales. Almost all students can sit in placement, and also zero placement support from the faculty of the college. Only 2 or 3 good companies are coming to the college, and the average package offered is 5 LPA, which is also the highest.
content.Infrastructure: Wi-Fi speed is average of 20 Mbps. The computer lab is excellent almost all pc are new. The canteen and mess food are also okay not that good. There is also no good opportunity in the sports field. The college environment is also not good. Classroom does not have smart boards.

individual_reviews.course: B.Tech. in Computer Science and Engineering - Batch of 2027
individual_reviews.title: Overall relentlessly intolerable college and staff .

content.Placements: About 10 percent of students were placed last year in my college. The highest package offered is about 4–5 LPA maximum, and the lowest is about 2 LPA. Top recruiters are TCS and local startups from Jaipur, etc. About 10–20 percent of students got internships through the college curriculum. Top roles in the course are junior developer, tester, senior software developer, and web designer, etc. You can expect these roles.
content.Infrastructure: The given and offered facilities are limited and very poor for my course. Sometimes necessary facilities like water are not there, and the water quality is also awful. Wi-Fi works sometimes and often goes offline. Labs are there, but not a single system works efficiently, and some of them are just trash with the lowest processors. There is only one central library, which opens at 10 am and closes at 5 pm, which is very basic. Hostel food is poor with no hygiene. The dining area is awful because of bad smell and poor maintenance. The food is tasteless, and the canteen closes at 9 pm.

review_summary.college_name: Goutham College Reviews on Placements, Faculty & Facilities

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2018
individual_reviews.title: The college has knowledgeable staff and good placements.

content.Placements: 50% of the students were placed, with salaries ranging from Rs. 80,000 to 1.5 LPA. The institutions offering placements included Manipal Hospital, Narayana Hospital, Spandan Hospital, Victoria Hospital, and Government Hospital 99 in Yeshwantpur and Narayana Hrudayalaya. We secured internships and postings as senior staff nurses.
content.Infrastructure: Our college is equipped with labs, classrooms, and a library. The hostel was clean, and the food quality was good, matching our cultural preferences. Medical facilities were readily available, as it is a nursing college, and various types of labs were present, including an Obstetrics and Gynecology lab and a medical-surgical nursing lab. Sports events are conducted annually.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2025
individual_reviews.title: Not that much good environment of college campus but college teachers are very helpful.

content.Placements: Not that much good. Very low percentage of students get placement opportunities. But they give 100% internships for 6 months. 3 to 4 companies are interested to take freshers. As a stuff nurse, you may start a job in the corporate hospital.
content.Infrastructure: The boys' hostel is a dump of dustbin. The food quality is very bad. There is no Wi-Fi. The college is very good. There is no canteen in our college. Labs are good but they practice old technology. Yearly once, the college conducts annual sports.

individual_reviews.course: Diploma in Medical Laboratory Technician - Batch of 2022
individual_reviews.title: Goutham college of physiotherapy and goutham group of institution and its excellence .

content.Placements: Our package is 4L per year. The top role offered is of a therapist. A laboratory technician role is also offered.
content.Infrastructure: In the hostel, there are a lot of facilities available. The college offers a transport facility to the students. The hostel is good and Wi-Fi, a washing machine, and hot water are available. The food is okay in the hostel. Medical facilities are available. The sports park is nearby.
content.Faculty: Teachers are extraordinarily well educated and experienced. The teachers all Masters and Ph.D. Exams are easy not much difficult. The passing percentage is 50. 65 per cent is first class and less than that is second class.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2024
individual_reviews.title: It is a good college so you can have a good future here.

content.Placements: Almost 100% of students got placements after studying from here, and it is good. All the students studying here are working as professional nurses in a good hospital. They are working in a good post. After passing out from here, you will get so many opportunities to succeed in life.
content.Infrastructure: There are so many rules here that we need to follow. It is good, but we sometimes feel irritated to maintain the rules and regulations. The hostel is good, but the food served is not that good, and we have to adjust to it.

individual_reviews.course: B.Sc. in Nursing - Batch of 2023
individual_reviews.title: Review of Goutham College.

content.Placements: For placements, students have to go through a 6-month compulsory internship. It has industry exposure, to convert students into professionals. After successfully graduating, any students can register their name in the placements cell to be notified and for guidance regarding the job. The college has tie-ups with many reputed firms to placed the students to have a good career.
content.Infrastructure: Hostel accommodation is available for both girls and boys. The hostels are located adjacent to the college, and well furnished. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. Rules and regulations are strictly followed in the hostel premises. The negative point is that visitors are not allowed in the hostel even if they are not parents or guardians. There are very strict rules amended in the hostel. Though the food served is good in the hostel. I liked the hostel stay, and disliked a few things, but they are meant for our security itself.

admission_process.title: CIIMS Admission Process 2025

paragraphs: Currently,Christ Imperial Institute of Management and Scienceadmission 2025is open. The institute offers various courses such as BTech, BCA, BCom MBA etc at the UG and PG level. Apart from the UG and PG courses the institutions also offer DPharma courses. The institute is affiliated withBangalore University,Mysore Universityand BSS University. The admission procedure atCIIMSis entrance exam and offers more than ten courses. The institute also offers DPhrama courses for two years of duration. CIIMS also offers Lateral Entry for all the courses. For Lateral Entry admission, CIIMS's APL Admission Panel will assess candidates and will call for direct admission, if selected.
The application process atChrist Imperial Institute of Management and Scienceis an online procedure. Read the following article to know more about Sai Group of Institutions course admission 2025.

Christ Imperial Institute of Management and Scienceadmissions to all the courses are based on merit. Along with that, candidates must also fulfil the minimum eligibility requirements of the respective courses. Check below the course-wise eligibility & selection criteria for CIIMS course admission 2025:

Christ Imperial Institute of Management and Science admission process includes registration and preparation of a merit list for admission confirmation. Candidates must follow the below steps to get a seat in CIIMS:
STEP 1: CIIMS Application Process 2025
Candidates are required to apply online on the official website of the college. Candidates need to pay an application fee to complete the application procedure.
STEP 2: Selection Rounds
CIIMS shortlists candidates based on the Entrance exam. The college will display a provisional merit list.
STEP 3: Merit List andAdmission Confirmation
Once selection rounds are over, the college releases a merit list. To allot and confirm the seat candidates are required to pay the application fee at the admission receipt centre.

highlights.summary: Lalita Vidya Pratishthanam, Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth is an institute. Lalita Vidya Pratishthanam, Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth is approved by AICTE and offers a total of 20 courses at UG and PG levels in 9 specialisations such as Artificial Intelligence & Machine Learning, Business Analytics, Computer Science Engineering, Cyber Security and Electronics & Communication Engineering. Furthermore, it offer courses such as B.E. / B.Tech, MBA/PGDM, BCA, B.A. and BBA in Full Time mode. Lalita Vidya Pratishthanam, Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth fee structure includes a total tuition fee ranging from INR 1,80,000 to 10,00,000. Lalita Vidya Pratishthanam, Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth has an annual seat intake of 750 for all the programmes. It offers courses, in streams such as Engineering, Business & Management Studies, IT & Software, Humanities & Social Sciences and Teaching & Education. The institute has a safe and well-equipped campus with all the advanced facilities.

reviews.review_heading: It is a good college with good facilities and good placements.
reviews.review_text: The hostel provides a very good environment to study and also relatively good space. Faculty and the staff are very friendly. The college has well-kept infrastructure to support academics and curricular activities. The classrooms are spacious with proper ventilation and modern teaching aids such as projectors, smart boards, and dedicated departmental laboratories.

reviews.review_heading: College experience: Learning, growth & vibes.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of the college is good. The classrooms are neat, the campus is well-maintained, and all the facilities, like the library, labs, and common areas are updated and super student-friendly. Everything feels organized and comfortable which makes studying way

reviews.review_heading: Review of Lalita Vidya Pratishthanam, Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth.
reviews.review_text: The hostel is very hygienic. They provide necessary facilities for students. There are facilities like washing machines, elevators, and vending machines. Wi-Fi is also provided till midnight. Study tables and lamps are available for studying purposes.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely satisfied with the college, taking this college to complete the course was a good decisio
reviews.review_text: Our department has good Wi-Fi, well-equipped labs, smart classrooms and a library with updated resources. Hostel facilities are decent, the mess and canteen food is average, medical support is available on campus, and sports facilities are well-maintained.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely, now I am enjoying my life at Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth.
reviews.review_text: The Chellaram academic block building is fully air-conditioned, provides ultra-modern labs with good equipment, a library, high-speed free Wi-Fi and smart and highly facilitated classrooms. The hostel is a newly constructed building, and every room is furnished with new furniture. And have sports courts of badminton, cricket, kho-kho, football, basketball, etc. The mess provides healthy and tasty vegetarian foods.

reviews.review_heading: A modern university, but there are a lot of restrictions.
reviews.review_text: The hostel provides very good facilities and has better infrastructure, and also has a gym and sports ground in several places. The Wi-Fi connection is weak sometimes, especially in the rainy season, and there's a mini ambulance in case of any medical emergency.

reviews.review_heading: Good placements in the year 2027.
reviews.review_text: There are well-equipped labs for specialised subjects and a comprehensive library with both physical and digital resources, and high-speed Wi-Fi across the campus. Well-maintained, clean, and provide basic amenities like cupboards and Wi-Fi. High-quality food, with a variety of vegetarian options. They have a spacious sports ground with facilities for games like cricket, football, and other sports.

reviews.review_heading: Best campus experience with vibrant events.
reviews.review_text: The college offers well-equipped labs and a smart classroom. They provide a strong Wi-Fi and an excellent library system. Spacious classroom and dedicated space for sports. Overall the campus is clean, organised, and thoughtfully designed to ensure a good experience.

reviews.review_heading: Best college and good facilities.
reviews.review_text: College infrastructure is good. Classrooms are high tech. Labs and library have AC. Mess food is bad. Canteen snacks are tasty but it is a little more costly. Free Wi-fi in all classrooms. Many sports items. There are many clubs for programmes.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely happy to study at Chinmaya.
reviews.review_text: Chinmaya has very good labs and classrooms. It also has Wi-Fi facility. The atmosphere there is suitable for all kinds of studies. Students studying there will also benefit from it. When a great environment and a great learning method come together, it creates wonders.

reviews.review_heading: One of the most worth full universities in Kerala and in India.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure which the college is providing is unbelievable, something we may not have expected before joining the college. This is very nice.

reviews.review_heading: Absolutely dissatisfied because of faculty members.
reviews.review_text: Hostel is really good. It is well-maintained, clean, and provides a comfortable environment for students to stay and study.

reviews.review_heading: The worst college ever. They behave very rudely.
reviews.review_text: The food is not good and unhygienic. The hostel facilities are good. The staff here is very bad. They are involved in improper behavior. The medical room is not working properly without proper equipment and medicine. Sports activities are conducted but without any proper preparation.

reviews.review_heading: The college is actually good, but they want to improve many things.
reviews.review_text: The infrastructure of Chinmaya Vishwa Vidyapeeth is good, but the construction is not yet finished and is still progressing. It may take around 1 to 2 years for the construction to be completed, and the infrastructure may become better. The Wi-Fi, labs, classrooms, and library are very good now, and in the future, it will get high-tech.

reviews.review_heading: An Average and Facilitated College in Kerala.
reviews.review_text: The university offers a variety of relevant courses for the modern world, like data science, robotics, machine learning, and a lot more. The university hostel inside the campus can accommodate about 450 students, and the university also has 2 hostels outside the campus. The university also arranges PG facilities for students in collaboration with a catering company. Chellaram Block on the campus has 3 fully functioning computer labs, a chemistry lab, and other facilities. 60-seat-wide classroom...
